# Galileo Music 0.1.8 (35)
This is a local development build of the native macOS Music app. It is not Developer ID signed or notarized, and it is not public-download-ready.
## What's new
- Clean first-run library setup falls back to an app-owned Music Library folder when Leo's development reference is unavailable. - Rights-aware YouTube import uses the verified app-managed yt-dlp runtime, Deno, and ffmpeg helpers, with bounded retries, resumability, and long-file deadlines. - Artwork is validated and identified by the downloaded content so one video's cover cannot silently replace another video's cover. - A single named primary window is reused across close, reopen, and app activation, while normal saved geometry is preserved. - The Jarvis bridge remains local-only on `127.0.0.1` and exposes diagnostics for helper readiness, imports, playback, library sync, and window controls.
## Verification
- Swift regression suite: 169 tests passed. - Hamilton full-length import: 142:36, complete decode and embedded artwork verified; playback is left paused. - The local DMG contains only `Music.app` and an Applications shortcut.
See `DISTRIBUTION.md`, `PRIVACY.md`, `SUPPORT.md`, and `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` for the current boundaries and release checks.
